purpose: Triangulate captured intent against every materially applicable Mission Kit axiom.

stages.operation: Capture stable source bytes and classify every indexed axiom provisionally.
Map applicable axioms to the complete candidate Round-1 interpretation.
Re-evaluate and map applicable axioms to complete Round-2 meaning.
Prove every snapshot member has a decision and every consequence an evidence reference.
Verify frozen bytes and mapping digests without reading the repository.

selection.include: Include an axiom when its mandate materially constrains captured intent.
selection.defer: Defer an axiom when later round meaning is required to decide applicability.
selection.nonMaterial: Mark non-material only with a recorded reason tied to current evidence.

completeness: Every indexed axiom has exactly one included, deferred or non-material disposition.
evidenceProduct: Session-bound mappings, decisions, item digests and aggregate snapshot digest.
